label: From futures to balancing: the market's timeline
context: Animate the sequence of German electricity markets for one delivery quarter-hour (tomorrow 18:00-18:15) as a horizontal timeline running left to right, with a moving cursor and a caption per phase (about 4 s each, loop). Time axis labels (not to scale, use segments): 'years-months before', 'D-1 12:00', 'D-1 15:00', 'D 17:55', 'D 18:00-18:15', 'after'. Phase 1 'Futures and forwards (EEX, OTC)': a retailer and a generator hedge a 100 MW baseload for next year; show a bar '100 MW bought at 85 EUR/MWh'. Phase 2 'Day-ahead auction, D-1 12:00 (EPEX SPOT / Nord Pool, coupled across Europe via SDAC)': many bid and ask arrows flow into an auction box; the box outputs 96 quarter-hour prices for tomorrow (draw a small bar chart of 96 thin bars with a midday dip and an evening peak); highlight the 18:00 bar '112 EUR/MWh'; note 'one uniform price per quarter-hour for all of Germany and Luxembourg'. Phase 3 'Intraday auctions (IDA1 15:00 D-1, IDA2, IDA3) and continuous intraday until 5 minutes before delivery': the forecast for wind falls by 400 MW; the retailer buys 400 MW more in continuous trading, ticks of trades flash with changing prices 118, 125, 131. Phase 4 'Delivery and balancing': at 18:00 a power plant trips; the grid frequency dial dips from 50.000 Hz to 49.95 Hz; three reserve bars activate in order labelled 'FCR within 30 s', 'aFRR within 5 min', 'mFRR within 12.5 min'; frequency recovers to 50.000. Phase 5 'Imbalance settlement': each balancing group's schedule vs actual; the gap is priced at the imbalance price (reBAP); show 'deviation -20 MW x 15 min x 300 EUR/MWh'. Use ink #04204B, accents #0B4FC0 and #B4552F, teal #138374; text >= 12 px; white background.

spec.title: From futures to balancing: the market timeline for 18:00-18:15 tomorrow
spec.caption: A cursor moves along a segmented timeline (not to scale) through the five phases for one quarter-hour. Futures hedge 100 MW at 85 EUR/MWh. The day-ahead auction sets 96 prices, with 112 EUR/MWh at 18:00. Intraday trading covers a 400 MW wind shortfall at 118, 125 and 131 EUR/MWh. Reserves restore 50.000 Hz after a plant trip. Imbalance settlement prices the -20 MW gap.
